answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to the competitive programming task. This task requires understanding a complex natural language description of a problem ... and correctly implementing solutions ... We use large language models as black-box generators and generate the program based on the problem description.
answer_1.outputs: source code solutions for competitive programming problems
